Management Plan  
- Likely diagnosis: labyrinthitis (inflammation/imbalance in middle ear)  
- Symptomatic treatment prescribed: medication (name not specified) one tablet three times daily for 10 days; dose/route/frequency partially documented (oral tablet, thrice daily, 10 days)  
- Follow-up: examination by a doctor including ear examination, gait assessment, blood pressure monitoring  
- Advice: urgent presentation to emergency department if weakness of limbs, sudden headache, violent vomiting occur  
- Prescription sent electronically to Lloyd Pharmacy  
- Patient advised to book follow-up appointment promptly  
- Medication can be taken with or without food depending on nausea status
